note.zh: 由面部肌肉的解剖几何驱动的参数化面部表情：肌肉激活 → 皮肤和深层部件的位移；FACS 动作单元是肌肉激活的组合；疼痛强度映射到动作单元强度。这是疼痛行为的计算模型，用于教学；模拟人并没有主观感受。没有使用任何真人面部数据。
note.en: A parametric facial expression driven by the anatomical geometry of the facial muscles: muscle activation → displacement of the skin and deep parts; FACS action units are combinations of muscle activations; pain intensity maps to action unit intensities. This is a computational model of pain behaviour for teaching; the simulated body has no subjective experience. No data of real faces was used.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：降眉间肌（depressor glabellae，即 procerus）、降眉肌、皱眉肌。模型里没有降眉肌。
note.en: Muscular basis: depressor glabellae (procerus), depressor supercilii, corrugator supercilii. The model has no depressor supercilii.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：眼轮匝肌眶部。下睑随颊部被推高的 0.4 是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: orbicularis oculi, pars orbitalis. The 0.4 for the lower lid being pushed up with the cheek is an assumption.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：眼轮匝肌睑部。上睑下落 0.35（睑裂变窄而不闭合）是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: orbicularis oculi, pars palpebralis. The 0.35 of upper-lid lowering (a narrowed, not closed, eye) is an assumption.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：提上唇鼻翼肌。
note.en: Muscular basis: levator labii superioris alaeque nasi.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：提上唇肌（眶下头）。
note.en: Muscular basis: levator labii superioris, caput infraorbitalis.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：笑肌，颈阔肌协同。颈阔肌的 0.5 是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: risorius with platysma. The 0.5 for platysma is an assumption.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：降下唇肌，或颏肌、口轮匝肌放松。这里只用降下唇肌，0.6 是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: depressor labii inferioris, or relaxation of mentalis or orbicularis oris. Only the depressor is used here; 0.6 is an assumption.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：咬肌；颞肌和翼内肌放松。表现为颞下颌关节张开；jawFraction 0.35 和降下唇肌 0.3 是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: masseter; relaxed temporalis and internal pterygoid. Realised as opening of the temporomandibular joint; jawFraction 0.35 and the 0.3 of the lip depressor are assumptions.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：翼肌、二腹肌。表现为颞下颌关节张到活动范围的上限；降下唇肌 0.5 是假设。
note.en: Muscular basis: pterygoids, digastric. Realised as the temporomandibular joint opened to the end of its range; the 0.5 of the lip depressor is an assumption.

note.zh: 肌肉基础：上睑提肌放松（眨眼 AU45 另有眼轮匝肌睑部收缩）。这里用上下睑两个通道到闭合线表示；强度按 0–5 连续取值，5 = 完全闭合，而 FACS 和 PSPI 里 AU43 只有有 / 无。
note.en: Muscular basis: relaxation of levator palpebrae superioris (the blink, AU45, adds contraction of the palpebral orbicularis). Realised as both lid channels travelling to the closure line; the intensity is continuous 0–5 here with 5 = fully closed, whereas in FACS and in the PSPI AU43 is only present or absent.

note.zh: 公式见 chen2018 和 egede2017（原始出处 prkachin2008 未打开）。各 AU 0–5，AU43 取 0 或 1，共 16 级。本模型里 AU43 连续取值，计入 PSPI 时：强度 ≥ 2.5 记 1，否则记 0；另给一个连续版本（AU43 / 5）便于检验单调性。
note.en: Formula as given by chen2018 and egede2017 (the original, prkachin2008, was not opened). Each AU is 0–5 and AU43 is 0 or 1, 16 levels in all. AU43 is continuous in this model; for the PSPI it counts 1 at intensity ≥ 2.5 and 0 below, and a continuous variant (AU43 / 5) is provided to test monotonicity.

note.zh: 假设。构造原则：强度越高，PSPI 各项不减；先出现降眉和睑收紧，再出现提颊和提上唇，高强度时才皱鼻、张口、闭眼；强度 10 时 PSPI 达到上限 16。关键帧之间线性插值。
note.en: Assumption. Constructed so that no PSPI term decreases with intensity; brow lowering and lid tightening appear first, then cheek raising and upper-lip raising, and nose wrinkling, mouth opening and eye closure only at high intensity; the PSPI reaches its maximum of 16 at intensity 10. Linear between keyframes.

note.zh: 假设。没有找到可公开核对的疼痛表情起始、峰值、消退时间统计；这三个数只是为了让动画不突兀。
note.en: Assumption. No openly checkable statistics of the onset, apex and offset times of pain expressions were found; the three numbers only keep the animation from snapping.

sources.citation: Chen Z, Ansari R, Wilkie DJ. Automated Pain Detection from Facial Expressions using FACS: A Review. arXiv:1811.07988 (2018).
sources.license: arXiv preprint; licence not shown on the page read. Facts only.

opened.zh: 读了 HTML 全文（ar5iv）。给出：Pain = AU4 + max(AU6, AU7) + max(AU9, AU10) + AU43；与疼痛相关的 AU 为 AU4、AU6/7、AU9、AU10、AU43，另列 AU12、AU20、AU25、AU26、AU27；PSPI 为 16 级量表；UNBC-McMaster 库有 48,398 帧、200 段视频。
opened.en: Full text read as HTML (ar5iv). States: Pain = AU4 + max(AU6, AU7) + max(AU9, AU10) + AU43; pain-related AUs are AU4, AU6/7, AU9, AU10, AU43, with AU12, AU20, AU25, AU26, AU27 listed in addition; the PSPI is a 16-level scale; the UNBC-McMaster archive holds 48,398 FACS-coded frames in 200 sequences.

sources.citation: Egede J, Valstar M, Martinez B. Fusing Deep Learned and Hand-Crafted Features of Appearance, Shape, and Dynamics for Automatic Pain Estimation. arXiv:1701.04540 (2017).
sources.license: arXiv preprint; licence not shown on the page read. Facts only.

opened.zh: 读了 HTML 全文（ar5iv）。给出：UNBC-McMaster 库 25 人、200 段、每段约 60–700 帧、共 48,398 帧；编码的 AU 为 AU4、6、7、9、10、12、20、25、26、27、43；强度为 A–E（0–5），AU43 只有有/无两种状态；PSPI = AU4 + max(AU6, AU7) + max(AU9, AU10) + AU43；82.71% 的帧疼痛得分为 0。
opened.en: Full text read as HTML (ar5iv). States: UNBC-McMaster has 25 subjects, 200 sequences of about 60–700 frames, 48,398 frames in total; the coded AUs are AU4, 6, 7, 9, 10, 12, 20, 25, 26, 27 and 43; intensity is A–E (0–5) and AU43 has only two states, present or absent; PSPI = AU4 + max(AU6, AU7) + max(AU9, AU10) + AU43; 82.71% of all frames have a pain score of zero.

sources.citation: Prkachin KM, Hammal Z. Computer Mediated Automatic Detection of Pain-Related Behavior: Prospect, Progress, Perils. Front Pain Res 2021;2:788606.

opened.zh: 读了出版社网页上的全文（前约 12 万字符）。给出：核心的疼痛动作是降眉（AU4）、眼眶收紧（AU6 或 7）、提肌收缩（AU9 或 10）和张口（AU25、26 或 27）；闭眼（AU43）在临床疼痛研究中也稳定地区分有痛与无痛；PSPI 是这些 AU 得分之和；UNBC-McMaster 库有 25 名参与者的 200 段视频。文中没有给出表情起始、峰值、消退的时间数值。
opened.en: Full text read on the publisher's page (about the first 120,000 characters). States: the core pain actions are brow lowering (AU4), orbit tightening (AU6 or 7), levator tightening (AU9 or 10) and mouth opening (AU25, 26 or 27); eyelid closing (AU43) also consistently discriminates pain from no pain in studies of clinical pain; the PSPI is the sum of the scores of these AUs; the UNBC-McMaster archive holds 200 sequences from 25 participants. It gives no numbers for onset, apex or offset times.

sources.citation: Kunz M, Meixner D, Lautenbacher S. Facial muscle movements encoding pain—a systematic review. Pain 2019;160(3):535–549.

opened.zh: 只读了摘要（经 Europe PMC）。给出：27 项实验性疼痛研究和 10 项临床疼痛研究中，稳定出现的疼痛相关 AU 是 AU4、AU6_7、AU9_10、AU25_26_27，临床疼痛中 AU43 更常见；这些 AU 多数时候并不同时出现，而是以不同方式组合，不存在一张统一的“疼痛脸”。
opened.en: Abstract only (via Europe PMC). States: across 27 experimental and 10 clinical pain studies the consistent pain-related AUs are AU4, AUs6_7, AUs9_10 and AUs25_26_27, with AU43 more frequent in clinical pain; these AUs are most often not displayed all at once but combined differently, so there is no uniform expression of pain.

sources.citation: Ashraf AB, Lucey S, Cohn JF, Chen T, Ambadar Z, Prkachin KM, Solomon PE. The Painful Face – Pain Expression Recognition Using Active Appearance Models. Image Vis Comput 2009;27(12):1788–1796.
sources.license: © Elsevier; author manuscript free to read at PMC3402903. Facts only.

opened.zh: 读了 PMC 上的作者稿。给出：逐帧的疼痛综合分是降眉、眼眶收紧、提肌收缩、闭眼四个动作的强度之和；各动作按 6 级强度编码（0 = 无，1 = 微量……5 = 最大）。
opened.en: Author manuscript read at PMC. States: the per-frame composite pain score is the summed intensity of four actions — brow lowering, orbit tightening, levator contraction and eye closing — each coded on a 6-level intensity scale (0 = absent, 1 = trace … 5 = maximum).

sources.citation: Prkachin KM, Solomon PE. The structure, reliability and validity of pain expression: Evidence from patients with shoulder pain. Pain 2008;139(2):267–274.

opened.zh: 没有打开正文（付费）。PSPI 的原始出处；公式是从 chen2018、egede2017 转引的。题录和 DOI 已对照 Crossref 记录核对。
opened.en: Full text not opened (paywalled). The original source of the PSPI; the formula is taken second-hand from chen2018 and egede2017. The bibliographic record and DOI were checked against Crossref.

sources.citation: Wikipedia contributors. Facial Action Coding System (table of main action units; intensity scoring).

opened.zh: 读了页面（2026-10-11）。AU 的名称和肌肉基础取自“主要动作单元”表；强度 A 微量、B 轻度、C 明显、D 严重、E 最大。FACS 手册本身（Ekman、Friesen、Hager 2002）不是开放资料，没有打开。
opened.en: Page read on 2026-10-11. AU names and muscular basis are taken from its table of main action units; intensities are A trace, B slight, C marked or pronounced, D severe or extreme, E maximum. The FACS manual itself (Ekman, Friesen, Hager 2002) is not open and was not opened.

sources.citation: soma knowledge layer (public/anatomy/knowledge/relations.json): origins and insertions of the facial muscles, each from a Wikipedia muscle infobox revision, Wikidata, or a Z-Anatomy attachment patch.

opened.zh: 读了本仓库已有的 relations.json 里面部肌肉的起止点条目（每条自带修订版链接）。muscles.json 里的 attachments 文字据此写成；“哪一端是起点”的几何方向是本项目据这些文字定的。
opened.en: The origin and insertion entries of the facial muscles in this repository's existing relations.json were read (each carries its own revision link). The `attachments` text in muscles.json follows them; the geometric direction that says which end is the origin is this project's reading of that text.

sources.citation: Waters K. A muscle model for animating three-dimensional facial expression. Computer Graphics (Proc. SIGGRAPH '87) 1987;21(4):17–24.
sources.license: Not open access. Paper not opened.

opened.zh: 没有打开论文本身，只核对了题录。线状肌（影响区内把皮肤拉向固定端，随距离衰减）和环状肌这两类参数化肌肉的想法出自这里；本项目的衰减函数和所有参数是自己定的，不是照搬。
opened.en: The paper itself was not opened; only the bibliographic record was checked. The idea of two kinds of parametric muscle — a linear muscle that pulls the skin in a zone of influence towards its fixed end with a falloff, and a sphincter — comes from here; the falloff functions and every parameter are this project's own, not copied.

cautions.zh: 这是疼痛行为（面部表情）的计算模型，用于教学；模拟人并没有主观感受。从疼痛强度到各动作单元强度的数值是构造的一种典型组合，没有出处；真人的疼痛表情因人而异。
cautions.en: This is a computational model of pain behaviour (the facial expression) for teaching; the simulated body has no subjective experience. The numbers from pain intensity to action unit intensities are one constructed canonical pattern without a source; real pain faces differ between people.

cautions.zh: 皮肤是一张连续的面，没有睑裂和口裂：皮肤视图里闭眼、分唇、张口只表现为表面的移动，看不到眼球和牙齿；这些动作要在肌肉视图里看。
cautions.en: The skin is one continuous surface with no eye or mouth opening: in the skin view eye closure, lip parting and jaw drop only move the surface and never reveal the eyeball or teeth; look at them in the muscle view.

cautions.zh: 面部皮肤只有约 1364 个顶点（平均边长 6.7 mm），画不出皱纹：眉间纵纹、鼻背皱纹、鱼尾纹、鼻唇沟的加深都没有，只有大块皮肤的移动。
cautions.en: The facial skin has only about 1364 vertices (mean edge 6.7 mm) and cannot show wrinkles: no glabellar furrows, nose wrinkles, crow's feet or deepening of the nasolabial furrow, only the bulk movement of the skin.

cautions.zh: 每块肌肉的位移场是线性的、互相叠加，皮肤只沿切面滑动：没有皮肤的隆起和堆积，没有组织之间的碰撞；深层部件跟随其上方的皮肤，肌肉会缩短但不会变粗。全激活时的位移幅度、作用范围和各动作单元里的肌肉权重都是假设。
cautions.en: Each muscle's displacement field is linear and the fields add; the skin only slides in its tangent plane: no bulging or bunching of skin and no collision between tissues; deep parts follow the skin above them, and muscles shorten without thickening. Excursions at full activation, zones of influence and the muscle weights within each action unit are assumptions.

cautions.zh: 数据里没有降眉肌、降鼻中隔肌和上睑板肌；AU4 只由皱眉肌和降眉间肌驱动。
cautions.en: The data has no depressor supercilii, depressor septi nasi or superior tarsal muscle; AU4 is driven by corrugator supercilii and procerus only.

cautions.zh: 眼轮匝肌两个部件的名字与几何相反：名为“眶部”的是贴着睑缘的内环，名为“睑部”的是外环。本层按几何（环的大小）而不是按名字来用它们。
cautions.en: The two orbicularis oculi parts carry names opposite to their geometry: the part named "orbital" is the inner ring at the lid margins and the part named "palpebral" is the outer ring. This layer uses them by geometry (ring size), not by name.
